sourceRefs.locator: Bonetto and Tiussi, city history on pp. 16–17. The sack in 452, its impact and continuing settlement around the episcopal complex. Photographs and plans of the river port.
Brief synthesis and property 825quater. Role of Mediterranean trade routes and the river port, surviving quays and warehouses, coordinate of the archaeological area.

labels.en: The sack of the port city

note.de: Attilas Heer nahm Aquileia ein. Das spätere Leben um den Bischofssitz lässt sich auch nach der Plünderung verfolgen.
note.en: Attila’s army captured Aquileia. Settlement around the episcopal complex continued after the sack.
